theorem gramBatchCheck_sound (width lanes p n mwidth cap : Nat)
    (stack g d S delta radius : Int) (xs : List GramRowInput)
    (h : gramBatchCheck width lanes p n mwidth cap stack g d S delta radius xs = true) :
    ∀ x ∈ xs,
      packedMatrixRowHeader mwidth n x.matrixWord = true ∧
      packedFactorLink width lanes p n x.row stack x.factorWord = true ∧
      smallFactorRowCheck width p x.row cap x.factorWord = true ∧
      packedUniformRowCheckAt width lanes p n x.row mwidth stack x.matrixWord g d S delta radius = true
